title: Installation Project Relief on Ridgeline Consumer Credit Late Fees — Training Note
content:
**What the relief is.** A Ridgeline Consumer Credit late fee is reduced by a project relief when the customer has been paying for Ridgeline Installation Services contracts with Ridgeline Consumer Credit. It counts the payments toward the customer's Ridgeline Installation Services contracts that were charged to Ridgeline Consumer Credit in the last 12 months (dated less than 12 full months before today):

| Installation-contract payments charged to Ridgeline Consumer Credit in the last 12 months | Project relief |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 4.00 |
| 1 or 2 | 2.00 |
| none | nothing |

**How it is applied.** The project relief is subtracted from the late fee once the sum of the fee level and the balance add-on has received its payment-pattern treatment, and before the late fee is limited to the latest statement's minimum payment due on a tier whose late fee is capped. The late fee is never below zero.

## Questions a new representative asks

**Where are these payments seen?** On the customer's Ridgeline Installation Services contracts: the payments received on each contract, each with its payment method and date. Only payments whose method is Ridgeline Consumer Credit count; payments by any other method do not.

**Exactly 3 such payments in the 12 months?** 4.00. **Exactly 1?** 2.00.

**Hypothetical, capped tier:** a late fee standing at 34.00 before the relief, a relief of 4.00 and a latest minimum payment due of 25.00: 34.00 less 4.00 is 30.00, then limited to 25.00. With a minimum payment due of 40.00 the late fee is 30.00.
